summary: Capital One Funding, LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $650 million tranche of Class A(2026-4) Card series notes issued by Capital One Multi-asset Execution Trust, with Capital One, National Association as sponsor, servicer and originator. Pricing is 99.96084% (about $649.75 million), 5.43% coupon, 0.30% underwriting discount, expected issuance October 8, 2026, expected principal payment September 15, 2031, legal maturity September 15, 2033. Joint bookrunners include J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Scotiabank. This is a routine credit-card ABS takedown, not a special situation; watch collateral performance and spread.
